title: fix(runtime)!: the /mcp bridge's list_actions, run_action and resume_run read an object's actions from the listing list_objects serves, so a package object's actions are listed and run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4BM6tVgxhg4qFQsbuRHiy9)_

Fixes #25139

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

The HTTP MCP bridge's three business-action tools, `list_actions`, `run_action` and `resume_run`, now collect the actions declared on objects from the object definitions `list_objects` lists: the protocol's merged listing, the one `GET /api/v1/meta/object` serves (#25120). They read the `metadata` service's `listObjects()` until now, so on a kernel with an `environmentId` they saw none of the actions on an object a package registers during the boot, while `list_objects` listed the object and REST's `/actions` door ran the actions. The listing is read once per call through the same function `list_objects` uses, not copied.

## The defect, measured on base `cc8d886d4`

`collectActionDeclarations` (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`) built its object-embedded rows from `meta.listObjects()`, and `list_actions`, `run_action` (through `resolveActionByName`) and `resume_run` all read it. The `metadata` service holds a copy of an object only where something put one there. On a kernel with an `environmentId` (`createStandaloneStack`: `os dev` as `env_local`, `os serve`, `os start`; and the cloud single-environment runtime) nothing copies an object a package registers in the `SchemaRegistry` during the boot.

Real kernels (`ObjectKernel` + `MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` over a better-sqlite3 `SqlDriver`), the bridge the real `/mcp` entry hands the MCP service (`HttpDispatcher.handleMcp`), and REST's door driven through the same dispatcher (`POST /actions/OBJECT/NAME`). The fixture package: an object with a declarative update exposed to AI (`mark_done`), a script action exposed to AI whose handler is registered (`ping`), a declarative update not exposed (`hidden_done`), and a top-level action bound to the object (`bound_done`); and an `apiEnabled: false` object with a declarative update exposed to AI (`gated_done`).

| shape, when the package registered | `list_actions` | `run_action mark_done` on a record | `run_action ping` | REST `POST /actions/qa_act_open/mark_done` | REST `ping` |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `env_local`, during the boot | **none of the four** | **`Action 'mark_done' not found on object 'qa_act_open'`** | **`Action 'ping' not found on object 'qa_act_open'`** | `200`, the record updated | `200`, `{ pong: true }` |
| `env_local`, installed after the boot (`source: 'marketplace'`) | all four | the record updated | `{ pong: true }` | `200`, updated | `200` |
| no `environmentId`, during the boot | all four | the record updated | `{ pong: true }` | `200`, updated | `200` |
| no `environmentId`, installed after the boot | all four | the record updated | `{ pong: true }` | `200`, updated | `200` |

The MCP columns of the first row are the pins' main leg below, verbatim. The REST columns and the disabled-package reading come from a scratch probe over the same rig and fixture (object prefix `qa_pkg`), not committed.

Without `objectName`, `run_action mark_done` answered `Action 'mark_done' not found` on the first row and resolved on the other three. The bound top-level action rides inside the object's `actions` on every shape (in the merged listing and in the copy alike), so it followed the same split.

**A disabled package (`registry.disablePackage`).** On the shape without an `environmentId` the boot copied the objects into the `metadata` service, actions and all, and the copy outlives the disable: `list_actions` listed all four and `run_action ping` ran the handler (`{ pong: true }`), while `list_objects` and `describe_object` omit the objects since #25120 and `GET /api/v1/meta/object` omits them. On `env_local` there is no copy, so the bridge already listed none and answered "not found".

## What changed

- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`.** `buildMcpBridge` gains `readServedObjects()`: the merged listing (`readMergedObjects`, unchanged from #25120), or the `metadata` service's `listObjects()` on a host with no merged read. `list_objects` now lists through it (its answer does not change), and `list_actions`, `run_action` and `resume_run` collect object-embedded actions from it. `resumeActionRun`'s wiring gains an optional `readObjects`.
- **`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`.** `collectActionDeclarations(deps, meta, objects?)` and `resolveActionByName(deps, meta, name, objectName?, objects?)` take the object listing as an optional last input; left out, they read `meta.listObjects()` as before, so REST's activation-ambiguity check, the one other caller, is unchanged. `invokeBusinessAction`'s wiring gains an optional `readObjects`. Standalone `action` rows are still read from `meta.loadMany('action')`, and an object-embedded declaration still wins a clash. None of these functions is published by `index.ts`.
- **`.changeset/25139-mcp-actions-merged-object-view.md`.** A `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime`, with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; both declaration lines are in the body.

## Contract

Every input whose answer changes, old to new, on `POST /api/v1/mcp`:

1. **`list_actions` on a kernel with an `environmentId`, for an action declared on an object a package or plugin registered during the boot** (inside the object, or a top-level action bound to it). Old: not listed. New: listed, behind the same filters (headless-invokable, a registered handler for a script action, `ai.exposed`, `requiredPermissions`).
2. **`run_action` for such an action.** Old: `Action 'NAME' not found on object 'OBJECT'`, or `Action 'NAME' not found` without `objectName`. New: resolved and dispatched behind the same gates as on every other shape, as REST's `/actions` door runs it.
3. **`resume_run` of a run started by such a flow action.** Old: refused `403` (no flow action it could see targets that flow). New: admitted through `run_action`'s gates. Pinned with doubles, not on a real automation engine.
4. **The three tools on a disabled package's actions, where the `metadata` service still holds a copy of its objects** (the narrowing; every kernel without an `environmentId`, and a marketplace install on any kernel). Old: listed; `run_action` ran a script action's handler, and refused a declarative update at the record load (`RECORD_NOT_FOUND`). New: omitted from `list_actions`; `run_action` answers `Action 'NAME' not found on object 'OBJECT'`; `resume_run` refuses their runs `403`. As `describe_object` answers their objects "not found".
5. **An object whose served definition differs from the `metadata` service's copy.** Old: its actions came from the copy. New: from the definition REST serves.
6. **The three tools while the protocol's merged listing throws.** Old: the `metadata` service's listing. New: the protocol's error reaches the caller, as `list_objects` lets it since #25120; nothing falls back. Pinned with a throwing double, not on a real store outage.

Unchanged: actions on objects that already had a copy are listed and run as before. Standalone `action` rows, a host with no `protocol` service or one without the merged listing (it reads the `metadata` service), every gate after resolution, and REST's `/actions` door, which still resolves through `ql.getSchema` and the registry. The published surface does not move: `@objectstack/runtime`'s `index.ts` exports none of the four functions, and each gains only an optional trailing input. The parity target the card names is met: on every row of the table above, `run_action` now answers what REST's door answers the same request (pinned: the declarative update, an absent record, the script action).

## Pins

- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts`, 36 new cases on real kernels, in #25120's rig (106 in the file).** For each of the four rows above: `list_actions` lists exactly `gated_done`, `bound_done`, `mark_done` and `ping` on the package's two objects, and not `hidden_done`; `run_action mark_done` updates a seeded record (read back through `get`), and REST's door updates another, `200`; without `objectName` on an absent record both answer `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / `404`; `bound_done` updates a record; `ping` answers `{ pong: true }` through the handler, as REST does; `hidden_done` is resolved and refused at the exposure gate; and a name nothing declares is still `Action 'qa_nowhere' not found on object 'qa_act_open'`. For a disabled package on both shapes: `describe_object` answers null (precondition), `list_actions` lists none of the package's actions, and `run_action` answers "not found" for `mark_done`, `ping` and `bound_done`, scoped and unscoped; on the shape without an `environmentId` a precondition shows the copy still holds the actions. The rig's `bridgeFor` takes an optional caller (default unchanged), so these cases carry a `tenantId` and can seed records.
- **`packages/runtime/src/mcp-resume-run.test.ts`, 3 new cases, doubles (25 in the file).** With a merged listing that serves the object and a `metadata` service that lists nothing: `run_action` starts the screen flow and `resume_run` completes it, the `metadata` service's `listObjects` never asked; `list_actions` lists the object's three exposed and permitted flow actions. With a merged listing that throws: `list_actions`, `run_action` and `resume_run` fail with its error, the `metadata` service is not asked, and the engine's `resume` is not called. The harness's `merged` option is additive; every existing case runs as before.

**Red before, green after.** Each leg's direction was predicted before it ran; all six runs read both pin files (131 cases), on `c5e95a9d` over `cc8d886d4`. The final head is that commit cherry-picked onto the newer `origin/main` (no `packages/runtime` file moved between the two bases) with one change in the pin file: a precondition's local is typed instead of `any`, which lint flagged. Both pin files were re-run on the final head (below). Mutations were landed and restored by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed; restored blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). These files import the runtime's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

| leg | mutation | failed | which |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| main | the base tree's `action-execution.ts` and `domains/mcp.ts`, with the new pins | 13 | the six `env_local` during-boot cases, the four no-`environmentId` disabled-package cases, the three `resume_run` cases |
| listactions | `list_actions` collects from the `metadata` service | 4 | the two real-kernel `list_actions` cases (`env_local` during the boot; disabled without an `environmentId`), the unit listing case, the throwing case |
| invoke | `run_action` resolves against the `metadata` service | 10 | the five `env_local` during-boot `run_action` cases, the three disabled-package `run_action` cases, the unit resume case (its `run_action` start), the throwing case |
| resume | `resume_run` admits against the `metadata` service | 2 | the unit resume case (`403`), the throwing case |
| collect | `collectActionDeclarations` ignores the listing it is given | 12 | every real-kernel case the main leg failed, the unit resume and listing cases |
| fix | `c5e95a9d` | 0 | 131 passed |

## Local verification

On `ae2b2bc5ff`, the final commit, over `origin/main` `bda53bb0ba`, unless a line says otherwise. Every heavy run went through the verify lock, and each line cites its `VERDICT`.

- `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=2` (the runtime's closure included): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 66 of 66 tasks.
- Both pin files (`npx vitest run src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts src/mcp-resume-run.test.ts` in `packages/runtime`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 131 passed.
- `@objectstack/runtime` unit suite (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 435 passed (435); Tests 6924 passed, 19 skipped (6943).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (`tsc --noEmit`, and `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The first lint of the changed files, on `c5e95a9d`, answered one error (a service-lookup result erased to `any` in a pin's precondition), fixed before the final head.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 68 families derived; each run, every one `exit 0` (a first pass on `efcb85dc` over `cc8d886d4`, the same five files, also answered 68 of 68 `exit 0`).
- `--ran` reconciliation: `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event PAYLOAD`, with PAYLOAD a `pull_request` event carrying this title and body: exit 0 (`✓ LEVEL AXIS`: `no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, a non-protocol change at `patch`).
- `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --body` on this body: exit 2, its "closing declarations found" answer: `Fixes #25139` and nothing else, bound by the duplicate-fix guard's and the part-of guard's parsers.
- The full dogfood battery, once, on the final head (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 289 passed, 3 skipped (292); Tests 2491 passed, 18 skipped (2509); no failure. Owed by the `!` and the `(narrowing)` arm; the PR's Dogfood shards skip on pull requests.

## Acceptance notes

- **Found while measuring, not changed here: REST's `/actions` door runs a disabled package's script action.** `POST /actions/OBJECT/ping` answered `200 { pong: true }` for a disabled package's object on both shapes (its declarative update is refused at the record load), while the data plane refuses the object `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. After this change the MCP door answers "not found" there; the REST door is a different door and a different card.
- **Found while measuring, not changed here: a package's object-less action is invisible to MCP on every shape.** A top-level action with no `objectName` (a `global` action) is in the registry's `action` items and REST's `POST /actions/global/NAME` runs it, but `collectActionDeclarations` reads standalone rows only from `meta.loadMany('action')`, which holds the environment-authored rows alone, so `list_actions` never lists it and `run_action` answers `Action 'NAME' not found` on both shapes. Not this card's shape defect.
- **REST's activation-ambiguity check still collects from the `metadata` service.** `refuseAmbiguousActionActivation` (`domains/actions.ts`) is the one other caller of `collectActionDeclarations`; it passes no listing, so its reading on an `environmentId` kernel is unchanged. Not MCP, and not measured here.
- **Each call reads the whole merged listing once**, as `list_objects` and `describe_object` do since #25120.
- **Branch name.** This PR's branch is `claude/project-thread-dkk3hd`, the name the session was given, not `claude/issue-25139-…`; the Duplicate Fix Guard may say so. It carried #25268 (#25245) until that merged, and was restarted from `origin/main` for this card.
